[[File:Satoshi Yamamoto.png|200px|thumb|right|Yamamoto's avatar[https://archive.is/TeGVr The official Pokémon Adventures website.]]] [[File:Satoshi Yamamoto Picture.png|200px|thumb|right|Yamamoto in 2016[https://archive.is/k4VoS Press release detailing Yamamoto and Kusaka's appearance at ComicCon 2016]]] '''Satoshi Yamamoto''' (Japanese: '''山本サトシ''' ''Yamamoto Satoshi'', born December 17, 1965 in Kyoto) is a Japanese illustrator. He is best known for illustrating [[Pokémon Adventures]] from {{PAV|10}} onward. Aside from his work on various Pokémon manga, he has also illustrated some cards for the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]]. In 2016, Yamamoto and [[Hidenori Kusaka|Kusaka]] were both awarded the Comic-Con International's Inkpot Award.[https://web.archive.org/web/20230926191426/https://www.comic-con.org/awards/gallery/2016-photo-gallery 2016 Comic-Con Photo Gallery] Later that year, they were also awarded the {{tt|Mejor Kodoma Manga|Best Children's Manga}} award in the XXII {{wp|Salón del Manga de Barcelona}}.http://corocoro.tv/pokesp/story/0904/spain.html Yamamoto has mentioned that he uses the [[Scale World]] figures as a direct reference when drawing characters for his manga, such as [[Nemona]].[https://archive.is/akhq5 Yamamoto mentioning that he uses the Scale World figures as a direct reference when drawing characters for Pokémon Adventures.] ==Artwork== This is a collection of official Pokémon artwork drawn by Yamamoto. ===Draft pages=== This is a collection of draft pages that Yamamoto has publicly released for the Pokémon manga he is an artist on.
